name.local: 维亚生物 / 维亚生物创新中心(VBI)

strategy.thesis: Viva Biotech is a Hong Kong-listed structure-based drug discovery CRO that runs an 'Equity-for-Services' (EFS) company-creation arm, Viva BioInnovator (VBI): instead of (or alongside) cash, it exchanges its own drug-discovery R&D services for founding equity in new biotech startups, then supports them through to clinical stage or exit, functioning as a services-driven venture studio rather than a pure incubator-for-rent.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: In-house structure-based drug design (SBDD) and integrated biology/chemistry CRO platform underpins the EFS incubation mechanism; VBI unit created 2017.

track_record.portfolio_count: 90+ companies incubated via EFS since 2017 (per VBI); a related company update cites 87 EFS-incubated startups with 185 pipelines, 20 in clinical stage

sources.title: 业务简介 - EFS投资孵化业务
sources.quote: 维亚生物创新中心（Viva BioInnovator，VBI）是维亚生物（Viva Biotech Holdings 1873.HK）投资孵化和以服务换股权（EFS）业务的核心部门

sources.title: 投资孵化90多家Biotech、十亿级并购，维亚模式的核心是什么？
sources.publisher: 医药魔方 PharmCube / 研发客
sources.supports: founding year, VBI portfolio size and pipeline stats
sources.quote: 维亚生物创新中心（VBI）自2017年创立以来，投资孵化了来自全球的90多家创新药企业，其中中国公司20余家。所投公司共计有200多条管线在持续推进，近40条管线最终进入了临床的不同阶段

verification_notes: Known-anchor entity for this segment; parent Viva Biotech Holdings is HKEX-listed (1873.HK), headquartered Shanghai Pudong. Two sources give slightly different EFS portfolio counts (87 vs 90+) reflecting different snapshot dates; both corroborate the core EFS company-creation model.

aka: 飞镖生物医药创新研发中心
ATLATL北京飛鏢國際創新平臺

strategy.thesis: Runs a 'Lab Space as a Service' model — shared Class-A wet labs, on-site CRO services, and specialized platforms (gene/cell therapy, AI drug screening, GMP process development) staffed by resident scientists — that converts the traditionally heavy fixed-asset cost of founding a biopharma startup into a light, shared-infrastructure model, positioning itself as an origination/company-creation hub for new biomedical ventures rather than a landlord.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Origin model from Boston, localized/upgraded for China starting 2017; offers gene & cell therapy, AI drug screening, large-molecule research, gene editing, single-cell high-throughput screening, GMP process optimization, and preclinical pharm/tox platforms with on-site scientist and project-management teams.

program.location: Shanghai Zhangjiang; Beijing; Greater Bay Area (China); also Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia

sources.title: ATLATL official site
sources.quote: a global innovation research and development center... creates a new life sciences ecosystem by partnering with entrepreneurs, investors, pharmaceutical companies, and service companies

sources.title: 从共享空间到共享科技，ATLATL助力全球生物医药创新
sources.quote: 截至目前，飞镖在全国已累计服务超过150家企业和项目，帮助企业融资超过120亿元，培育企业累计获得80项专利、25个临床批件，并有2个产品获批上市

verification_notes: KNOWN ANCHOR for this segment. Official contact address on atlatl.center is listed in Singapore (Biopolis), and the group also has Hong Kong/Australia sites, but its earliest and largest China presence is Shanghai Zhangjiang (per Charles River CRADL partner-site page and Jiefang Daily), so it is included here as a China-anchored operation with a foreign co-HQ. Could not verify from primary sources whether ATLATL itself takes founding equity in every resident company vs. a pure fee-for-service/rental relationship; classified as venture-studio per the research brief's known-anchor list, with that caveat.

strategy.thesis: AI/biocomputing platform company founded by Baidu's Robin Li (chairman) and ex-Baidu-Ventures CEO Liu Wei (co-founder/CEO); builds a large cross-modal biological foundation model and deploys it to originate and support new life-science ventures through its Hong Kong 'BioMap InnoHub' and the 'BioMap BioX' bio-computing acceleration program, acting as a platform for company creation rather than a traditional investment fund.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Reports a ~210-billion-parameter cross-modal biological large language model used across drug discovery, bio-manufacturing and healthcare tasks; BioMap InnoHub (Hong Kong) launched the BioMap BioX program aiming to support 50+ early-stage life-science R&D projects over five years.

sources.title: 快看｜李彦宏发起成立生命科学新公司“百图生科”
sources.quote: 百图生科是中国首家生物计算技术驱动的生命科学平台公司，成立于2020年9月25日，由百度创始人李彦宏牵头发起并担任董事长，原百度风投CEO刘维担任联合创始人和CEO

sources.title: 港投公司第二度出手 投向李彦宏孵化的Biotech公司
sources.supports: BioMap InnoHub / BioX incubation program in Hong Kong
sources.quote: 百图生科在香港设立首个国际创新中心（BioMap InnoHub），其首个落地项目是“生物计算创新加速计划（BioMap BioX）”，预计将在未来5年支持超过50个前沿生命科学早期研发项目

verification_notes: Primarily an AI/biocomputing platform company (not a legally distinct 'fund'), included here because its explicit stated mode of operating is to originate and incubate new life-science ventures (BioMap InnoHub/BioX) off its own foundation-model platform, analogous to a tech-driven venture studio. Reported total venture funding raised by BioMap itself (~$200M+ per Chinese-language coverage) is distinct from AUM deployed into portfolio companies and was not independently verified against a primary filing within the research budget.

name.en: Westlake University Future Industry Research Center — Biotech Incubation Platform
name.local: 西湖大学未来产业研究中心（生物医药孵化）

aka: 西湖大学云谷孵化平台

strategy.thesis: Centered on Westlake University's Yun Valley (云谷) campus in Hangzhou, this platform converts faculty research directly into named, founded spinout companies — providing lab space, scientific-advisory teams and dedicated industrial operating teams — rather than only licensing IP to outside founders, functioning as a university-embedded, Flagship-style company-creation engine.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Spinouts drawn from Westlake University's School of Life Sciences labs; named biotech spinouts include Westlake Therapeutics (西湖生物医药), Westlake Omics (西湖欧米), and Westlake Yun Valley Smart Medicine (西湖云谷智药, gene-therapy, founded by faculty researcher Dr. Lijia Ma).

Westlake Yun Valley Smart Medicine 西湖云谷智药

verification_notes: Not a single legally distinct fund entity but a university tech-transfer/venture-creation program; included in this segment (rather than as a plain university fund) because it explicitly founds and names spinout operating companies from in-house research, matching the company-creation scope of this slice.

name.local: 上海合成生物学创新中心

aka: 上海合成生物创新中心

strategy.thesis: Shanghai-government-backed, nonprofit synthetic-biology platform (unveiled April 2024 at Zhangjiang) that builds three sector transformation platforms — biomedicine, high-value molecules, bulk biochemicals — to move lab science from proof-of-concept through to investable, newly formed companies, staging capital across POC, VC and PE rounds rather than leaving founders to navigate the gaps alone.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Non-profit body jointly initiated by scientific/technology-service institutions and synthetic-biology industry partners under the Shanghai Science and Technology Commission; runs proof-of-concept validation with external peer review ahead of introducing outside VC/PE capital.

sources.quote: 上海合成生物学创新中心...是由重点科技服务机构和主要合成生物科创合作伙伴共同发起、上海市科委指导支持的非营利性民办机构...将围绕生物医药、高值分子、大宗生化产品三大领域建设转化平台

sources.title: One to Hundred in China: Inside Beijing's Scaling Machine
sources.supports: staged POC → VC → PE capital-sequencing model
sources.quote: $300k covers POC validation, two rounds of external peer review validate the science before private capital is introduced, VC comes in at $2-3M once the POC is credible, PE follows at $20M

verification_notes: Official launch and nonprofit structure confirmed via Shanghai municipal government source. The specific POC→VC→PE staged-funding company-creation mechanics are reported only in a single secondary (Substack) analysis and could not be corroborated against SSIC's own materials within the research budget; treat those specific dollar figures as unverified pending a primary source.
